_notes.schema: v4.8: every key here is read by hooks/scripts (tests/test_settings_example.py pins both directions). Booleans accept true/false or the strings "true"/"false"; a malformed value falls back to its default without resetting its section.
_notes.layout_version: Integer schema version. v3 is current (topic-FOLDER + dated-aspect layout).
_notes.auto_journal: Stop-hook journal cadence: every journal_every REAL user turns the main session dispatches a background memory teammate (templates/auto-journal-instructions.md).
_notes.journal: v3.6 active forgetting. raw_ttl_days: archive raw journals older than N days; max_bytes: also archive a >1-day-old journal over this size; salvage: lift curated `- [type]` entries into journal/_salvage.md first; auto_forget_enabled: run _forget.py from the Stop hook (once per day).
_notes.reflection: v4.0 self-review loop. `enabled` gates the review cadence (every turn_interval real turns a fresh-context judge is dispatched; deferred until the session log holds min_review_turns blocks). Per-turn capture into journal/sessions/ is gated by capture_enabled, which DEFAULTS to `enabled` — deliberately absent here so enabled:false stays a privacy opt-out (session logs sync to the git remote). max_prompt_chars is clamped to 8192.
_notes.gate: v3.6 write-time quality gate (deterministic). strict: reject hedged claims without evidence; english_only: curated entries must be English (journal stays bilingual).
_notes.tags: v4.0 deterministic auto-tagging on the write path (inline #tags + frontmatter tags:, indexed as a weighted FTS5 column).
_notes.topic_routing: min_keyword_overlap: keyword overlap a topic needs to receive a routed entry; default_topic: where an entry goes when nothing matches.
_notes.topic_layout: v4.1 aspect retention: when auto_archive_enabled is true the Stop hook archives aspects older than archive_threshold_days (newest 3 per topic always kept). Default off; run /mem-ops forget --aspects by hand.
_notes.workspace: default: workspace when nothing else resolves; auto_detect_from_cwd: match config.json workspace_map globs against the session cwd.
_notes.retrieval: index_archive: also index .archive/**.gz so forgotten material stays searchable with /mem-recall --archive.
_notes.sync: auto_sync_on_stop: debounced detached commit+pull+push from the Stop hook; min_interval_minutes: the debounce (floor 5).
_notes.doctor: auto_heal: let SessionStart run bin/doctor.sh detached to repair a stale plugin registration (no network). Also GOWTH_MEM_NO_AUTOHEAL=1.
_notes.native: v4.8: keep <ws>/memory/MEMORY.md (Claude Code auto memory, 200 lines / 25 KB, re-attached after compaction) as the bootstrap carrier. Wire a project with /mem-setup native. enabled:false → the SessionStart hook prints the ≤8,500-char fallback bootstrap instead.
_notes.recall: v4.8 per-prompt recall (UserPromptSubmit, BM25, no LLM). on_prompt_enabled: master switch; on_prompt_max_entries / on_prompt_max_chars: injection caps; on_prompt_min_terms: distinct query terms a chunk must contain; on_prompt_score_threshold: bm25 (negative, lower is better) a chunk must reach — calibrated on the live vault, see docs/SHIPPED-FEATURES.md v4.8.0; on_prompt_prompt_cap: chars of the prompt that are profiled.
_notes.memfile: v4.8 budget of the managed block in MEMORY.md (the host reads 200 lines / 25 KB; Claude's own notes share the file).
